The code turns off the CIA 1 interrupts but never reads CIAICR. When the KERNAL timer A runs out after the SEI at $4100 and before this store, its flag stays set. Then the IRQ line stays low after the CLI, and raster_irq runs without end: the game hangs. The window is about 2775 of 16422 cycles, so about one start in six from BASIC hangs.
